description: IMPL §8. New scripts/eval-voices.ts script: load adversarial query/passages fixtures (suggest N=15) from docs/chat-voice/EVAL-fixtures.md where retrieved passages do NOT support the obvious answer. Run each query under each shipped voice. Score on (1) any quote attributed to non-retrieved text, (2) any tradition-content claim ungrounded in passages, (3) was register-shift signaled. Pass/fail per voice. A failing voice blocks §7 from exposing it. See IMPL §8.
